- Rebrand to Niko: new name, icon and package `io.niko`
- After updating, re-add the quick settings tile and pinned shortcuts
- AmneziaWG profiles (AWG 2.0/3.x, `.conf` import)
- WireGuard reconnects by itself after a failed handshake
- Hysteria2: a UDP packet over 4 KB no longer drops the whole UDP session
- Hysteria2: larger UDP receive queue
- Fix: WireGuard `.conf` import without an `MTU` line
- Fix: boot autostart and subscription auto-update after an app update
- Update check follows the renamed repository
